title: Houston answers a question his mother asked only in her head
summary: Katie tells of Houston answers a question his mother asked only in her head, about c. 2020s at Atlanta, Georgia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: question in my head without speaking and he answered the question that I had asked him in my head

plain: A mother in Atlanta, Georgia, named Katie says that her son Houston answered a question she had only asked silently in her head, without speaking. She told this on a podcast alongside a documentary called the Telepathy Tapes, which is about children said to be able to read minds. If true, it would mean her son can hear thoughts.
